The hit dice bonus cells (the fomorian 13 + 1-3 and the grim 4+2-8 ranged cells read the low-end bonus; the falcon small carries the minus 1)
The book-average hit points (the floor(num x 3.5) + bonus formula; the grig reads the 2-5 print hp range midpoint - the atomie precedent)

The base xp cells (every letter-F and letter-G print carries the xp level prefix)
The xp per hit point cells
The ground move-rate cells (the ildriss reads the 3" rolling-fog rate; the gloomwing "/12" reads the 12 flight rate; Nil reads 0)
The magic resistance cells (Standard and See below read 0)
